about_the_game:
Hentai Senpai: Heavy Metal Warriors Original Soundtrack, composed by Kink Master Studios.
This soundtrack contains 19 tracks, provided in both mp3 and wav format. Songs with "(Explicit)" in the title have lyrics, all other songs are instrumentals.

To access the high quality wav files, go to Steam Settings > Music > Download high quality audio files.
